million_test_conditions: 32x32 screen and shadow map, warp=0, tessellation=1, hard method, llvmpipe; validates submission and valid output, not gaming-GPU performance.
limitations: Fixed field; box width shrinks as count grows; height remains fixed.
Adaptive NDC tessellation is a curvature heuristic, not an error bound.
Large scenes have no ARR quality oracle; performance reports contain no RMSE.
No per-object CPU culling. No per-instance transform buffer. GPU geometry and fragment costs remain.
Shadow mixing and intermediate-depth loss are unchanged.

manifest.wall_scope: prepare + render including CPU submission and synchronous GPU timestamp waits
